title: skilless pack
description: A list of skills to add together with `skilless add <pack>`.

name.description: Shown as where each skill came from. Defaults to the pack's address.

skills.description: Where to get each skill: a git repository (`github.com/owner/repo`), a folder or one skill inside one (`github.com/owner/repo/skills/foo`), any of them pinned with `#ref`, or a skilless address (`https://skilless.dev/skills/<uuid>`). A repository or folder brings every skill in it, including ones added later.
